note: Configuration case, IP/MPLS L3VPN, network-model side. One managed L3VPN over three PE routers, described in the IETF L3NM network view. Carries three false-cognate traps (route-distinguisher vs route-target; routing-policy vs service-policy; ce-neighbor vs bgp-neighbor) and one opaque vendor-coded item with no public meaning. ref=null marks an opaque item or native gap.

concepts.label: vpn-service
concepts.gloss: the managed end-to-end L3VPN as one network service
concepts.example: the ACME-L3VPN spanning PE1, PE2, PE3

concepts.label: vpn-node
concepts.gloss: the VPN instance instantiated on one PE, holding that PE's VRF for the service

concepts.label: vpn-network-access
concepts.gloss: the point at which a customer site attaches to the VPN on a PE
concepts.example: the ACME access on PE1 toward CE-A

concepts.label: ce
concepts.gloss: the customer-edge device that peers with the PE across an access
concepts.example: CE-A at the ACME headquarters site

concepts.label: route-distinguisher
concepts.gloss: the value prepended to a route to make each VRF's routes globally unique
concepts.example: 65000:101 on the ACME vpn-node at PE1

concepts.label: vpn-target
concepts.gloss: the extended-community value controlling which VRFs import and export a route
concepts.example: export 65000:1, import 65000:1 on the ACME hub

concepts.label: ip-connection
concepts.gloss: the IP addressing on an access: the PE-CE subnet and addresses

concepts.label: qos-profile
concepts.gloss: the quality-of-service profile applied to traffic on an access
concepts.example: gold profile: 200 Mbit/s CIR, low-latency queue

concepts.label: ne
concepts.gloss: a provider-edge router that hosts vpn-nodes for the service

concepts.label: routing-protocol
concepts.gloss: the routing protocol run between PE and CE across an access

concepts.label: routing-policy
concepts.gloss: the policy that filters and manipulates routes on import and export of a vpn-node
concepts.example: deny customer default, set local-pref on import at PE1

concepts.label: sla-report
concepts.gloss: the periodic SLA conformance report exposed for the service (network-model self-extension; no device-config counterpart)
concepts.example: monthly availability and latency report for ACME-L3VPN
